rebuttals.putForth: Cruz flew to Cancun while Texans froze in the dark.

rebuttals.text: Ted Cruz is the most disliked man in his own party's cloakroom.
Ted Cruz will grovel to anyone who insults his wife if it helps his career.
Ted Cruz told the base to "vote your conscience" when Trump needed him most.
Ted Cruz's opposition to Trump lasted exactly as long as his own campaign.
Ted Cruz has the highest unfavorables of any national Republican.
Ted Cruz's 2013 shutdown gambit achieved nothing but a news cycle.
